title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 — Section 29B (Fast track procedure)

content.overview: Section 29B enables parties to agree in writing to have their dispute resolved by a fast track procedure. The tribunal decides on written pleadings, documents and submissions; oral hearing only if all parties request or the tribunal considers it necessary. The award is to be made within the statutory fast-track period.
content.glance: Written fast-track by agreement; limited oral hearing; accelerated award timeline as provided.
content.study: Written agreement is required. Default mode is documentary determination. Oral hearing is exceptional. The award must be made within the period prescribed by section 29B.
